newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to begin processing AMR/British Air request.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to begin processing AMR/British Air request.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said Monday the U.S. Department of Transportation decided to begin processing the American-British Airways Plc's alliance application concurrently with negotiations for a new "open skies" agreement between the United States and the United Kingdom.

American Airlines said that in a decision issued March 21, the Department of Transportation rejected requests by Delta Air Lines Inc and Trans World Airlines Inc to delay consideration of the request until after the open skies agreement is concluded, and dismissed a request from United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp, to conduct a hearing on the proposed alliance.
